privacy.title: Privacy Policy | AILoveDigital
privacy.description: How AILoveDigital handles personal data on ailovedigital.com: what we collect through the contact form, who receives it, how long we keep it and your rights.
privacy.lead: How we handle personal data on ailovedigital.com.
sections: 1. Who is responsible for your data

The website ailovedigital.com is operated by "AI LOVE DIGITAL" LLC, Tax ID 1009781681 (“we”, “us”). We are the operator of the personal data described in this policy. You can reach us at info@ailovedigital.com.

• Contact form. When you send us a message through the form on the home page or the Contact page, we receive what you type: your name, your email address, your company (optional) and your message. We use it only to read and answer your enquiry and to discuss the work you ask about. By submitting the form you ask us to contact you and agree to this use.
  • Email, phone and WhatsApp. If you write to info@ailovedigital.com or contact us by phone or WhatsApp, we receive what you send us (for example your email address, phone number and message) and use it to reply.
  • Technical data. When your browser loads a page, the servers that deliver this website receive the technical data every web request carries: your IP address, the page requested, the date and time, and your browser and device type. We use it to deliver the website and keep it secure, not to identify you.

This website does not set cookies, does not use analytics or advertising trackers and does not build profiles of visitors. Fonts and scripts are served from our own domain, so loading a page does not send your data to font or script providers.

We do not sell your personal data. We use these service providers to run the website and our mailbox:

  • FormSubmit (formsubmit.co) — a third-party service that forwards contact-form messages to our mailbox. It handles the details you type into the form while forwarding them.
  • Contabo (virtual server hosting) — runs the server that delivers this website. It receives the technical data described above and our web server keeps access logs of it.
  • Our email provider — hosts the info@ailovedigital.com mailbox where your messages arrive.

We may also disclose data where the law requires it. Links on this website (for example to Instagram, WhatsApp and dailoq.az) lead to services run by others; when you follow them, their own privacy policies apply.
Some of these providers may store or process data outside Azerbaijan.

We keep an enquiry only as long as needed to answer it and to carry out any work that follows from it, and then delete it. You can ask us to delete your message earlier at any time.

The web server’s access logs (IP address, page requested, date and time, browser and device type) are rotated daily and deleted after about 14 days.

Under the Law of the Republic of Azerbaijan “On personal data” (11 May 2010, No. 998-IIIQ) you have the right to know what personal data we hold about you and to see it, to ask for it to be corrected or destroyed, to ask us to stop collecting and processing it, and to withdraw your consent in writing. To use any of these rights, email info@ailovedigital.com; we will respond as soon as we can.
If we change how we handle personal data, we will update this page and the date at the top.
